TEXT.English: Founded by consuming a Great General. Unlocks Wilderness Training and the Rite of Passage I-III promotion line throughout your civilization. One school per civilization; one doctrine per soldier. Training in an owned city is free once the unit reaches its next XP promotion threshold. If several schools are available, use a doctrine training action to choose. Ranks I-III cost normal promotions and their bonuses stack.

+5% attack and defence in forests and jungles. Free permanent doctrine training in an owned city after a Great General founds Doctrine - Rite of Passage. Requires enough XP for the next normal promotion; a retrain alone does not qualify. No XP or promotion level is spent. Each soldier may follow only one doctrine. Unlocks Rite of Passage I-III; the three ranks use normal promotions.
Requires this unit's preceding doctrine rank. Chosen with normal experience; bonuses add to all preceding ranks.

Great Generals found twelve national land doctrine schools; Great Admirals found four naval schools. Units train one free foundation and earn ranks I-III with normal experience. Disable to suspend school training, paid ranks and all doctrine bonuses while retaining learned ranks. Disabled by default. Older saves without the option offer a choice to enable it for the current game. The BUG checkbox changes this same saved rule in single-player games.

Changes the saved Combat - Military Doctrines game option. Switching OFF suspends bonuses and training but retains schools and learned ranks; switching ON restores their effects. Available during single-player games. Choose the game option during setup for multiplayer.

This save predates the Military Doctrines game option. Would you like to enable it for this game? Great Generals can found twelve national land doctrine schools and Great Admirals four naval schools. Units train one free foundation and earn ranks I-III with normal experience. Yes enables the option; No keeps it disabled. Your choice is kept when you save. You can change it later in BUG under Caveman2Cosmos - Game Settings.
